title: Sugar Factories Control Sindh Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Sugar Factories Control Sindh Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2002
SUGAR FACTORIES
CONTROL
(SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sugar Factories Control Act,
1950, as applicable to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd September, 2002]
No.S.Legis:1(27)/2002, dated
3-9-2002.-----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of the Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sugar Factories Control
(Sindh Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sugar Factories Control Sindh Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of Act No.XVII of 1950

ORDINANCE XXVII OF 2002
SUGAR FACTORIES
CONTROL
(SINDH AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXVII OF
2002
An Ordinance to amend the Sugar Factories Control Act,
1950, as applicable to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd September, 2002]
No.S.Legis:1(27)/2002, dated
3-9-2002.-----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of the Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of Act No.XVII of
1950.--In the Sugar Factories Control Act, .1950, as applicable to the
Province of Sindh, throughout the Act, for the word "Collector" the
words "Executive District Officer (Agriculture)", shall be
substituted.
